label: GO step, choosing a2 after a recent unrewarded trial
explanation: Reset-gate unit 2 fires almost only at GO (98% of activation mass). It never fires at D1 or when the reward input is 1, and essentially never when the model picks a1. Nearly all of its mass (90%) falls on GO steps where the policy picks a2 (choice logit strongly negative). Within those, it is boosted when one of the last two trials went unrewarded, and it builds up over runs of consecutive unrewarded a2 trials. The top windows are chains of r0 a2 trials with activation rising from 0.2 to 1.0. It also fades steadily with episode trial: rate 11 percent in trials 0-9, about 0 after trial 80. A small amount fires at D2 when S1 is shown. The recorded predicate uses only observed history plus the agent's own current choice (no future variables). It gives dev F1 0.48 and mass recall 0.83. Precision stays low (about 0.37) because many a2-after-loss GO steps do not cross threshold, likely tied to the within-episode decay. Adding ep_trial cutoffs or value thresholds did not improve F1. GO plus a2 alone gives mass recall 0.90 but precision 0.21.
